chapters.title: Northern Sonoma today
chapters.body: The Northern Sonoma AVA lies in Sonoma County; the UC Davis AVA Project lists it as established on 17 June 1985. Eight AVAs nested in it are outlined here: Alexander Valley, Chalk Hill, Dry Creek Valley, Green Valley of Russian River Valley, Knights Valley, Pine Mountain-Cloverdale Peak, Rockpile and Russian River Valley; Rockpile and Pine Mountain-Cloverdale Peak run past the frame edge. The highest ground in the frame, about 1,440 m, is in its northern part. Traces of five faults from the USGS UCERF3 fault model enter the frame, all right-lateral: the San Andreas (North Coast), Maacama, Rodgers Creek–Healdsburg, Bennett Valley and Collayomi faults. The gold lines are the AVA boundaries.
